name: Camouflage
effect: Turn into the object in front of you

name: Glide
effect: Press R when in the air to glide quickly through the sky

name: Magnet Rise
effect: Fly through the sky quickly. Adjust height with L / R. Use the Y button in front of an object to break it down

name: Rock Smash
effect: Breaks the rocks in front of you

name: Rollout
effect: Roll quickly forwards. Uses Rock Smash's meter when breaking rocks

name: Rototiller
effect: Tills soil to allow for the planting of seeds

name: Surf
effect: Press B when in the water to surf through it

name: Water Gun
effect: Press A to hydrate in a + shape

name: Stockpile Water
effect: Press ZR while in water and sucking in with Y to move water around to create ponds and waterfalls
unlock: Complete Piplup's request, and befriend Paldean Wooper

name: Waterfall
effect: Press A at a Waterfall to climb to the top
